daily_time_base: milliseconds since 00:00 UTC of the path date
binary_record: big-endian >IIIff : ms, ask_integer, bid_integer, ask_volume, bid_volume
aggregation: UTC minute buckets [start, start+60s); separate bid and ask OHLC from the same ticks; source order retained for equal timestamps; n_ticks counts all source records; no resampling fill; no outlier filtering
source_integrity: Every successfully acquired compressed day has SHA256 in daily_source_ledger.csv. HTTP errors are not treated as empty-market days.

resume_collector.requests: sequential; 3 to 5 seconds after the previous response
resume_collector.after_429: wait at least 600 seconds before retry; retain an outstanding cooldown when stopping on persistent 429
resume_collector.ledger: successful source days skipped; failed days first; attempts cumulative; preserve row schema
